contract.providers: D642C0 memory through existing naked BEF590 and D691B0 physical through existing real ReadFile BF5030. Each native site checks current profile/slot; no cached virtual selection across allocation.
contract.length: BE4300 delegates byte-identical existing naked BE42E0 source, retaining incoming actual-pointer slot bits on partial length reads. Slot38 checked by counted producer, not added to leaf.
contract.string: Temporary {0,0}; raw pool resize(length,1); capture temporary length/data; space20h fill; reload byte provider, read original declared length. Publish header+payload actual before output fields zeroed/resized/copied. Output is fresh constructor storage, with no old output release.
contract.copy: Captured temp pointer/length retained across payload call. Output copy length/data reread after output resize. BF7680 source binding uses memmove, omitting a zero-byte call like existing raw string helpers.
contract.normal_cleanup: After output copy set result bit then lower state1->0 before getter/return using captured data and length+1, never reread temp header.
contract.unwind: State1 destroys current temp header, then guarded state0 clears result bit and destroys output. After lowering to state0 a normal-temp-return exception destroys output without retrying temp return. Source __try/__finally schedules these actions; normal return skips exceptional actions.
contract.budget: BF0510 initialized actual-count word retains output pointer bits in a new frame; qualified BE4620 writes it on normal return. Debit modulo32 only after normal return. Raw wrappers load node/reader/budget without readiness/null guards.
